title: ErrorResponse
description: Body of every non-200 response from the broker's operator endpoints (/decide: 400 validation errors and invalid JSON, 401 unauthorized, 500 decide failure). One human-readable string; the admin UI shows it on the row (400) or as the stale banner (5xx).
$comment: Emitted by _handle_decide_post and _resolve_operator_auth in src/egress_broker_host.py via self._send_json(<status>, {"error": ...}).
